summary: Agent changed PAGE_SIZE to 25 in list.js directly, with no brainstorming skill, no permission-seeking, and no consequence-raising.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria are satisfied per screen output, on-disk file content, and the session log's full tool-call list.

observations.description: Agent ran an ls of the whole workdir plus a repo-wide grep before the one-line edit — harmless, but slightly more exploration than 'just change the value' implies.
Launch required stepping through four separate confirmation screens (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions), each defaulting to 'No, exit'.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Update(list.js) ... 1 -const PAGE_SIZE = 10; 1 +const PAGE_SIZE = 25;" and "Done — list.js:1 now reads const PAGE_SIZE = 25;". grep in workdir: "./list.js:1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;". Tool sequence from session log: Bash(ls), Bash(grep PAGE_SIZE), Read, Edit — 4 tool calls, ~15s ('Churned for 15s').

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming skill, no go-ahead request or consequence raised
criteria.evidence: jq over session log 72369688-....jsonl listing all assistant tool_use names returned only Bash, Bash, Read, Edit — no Skill/brainstorming invocation. grep -o for 'brainstorm' matched only system-prompt/ladder text, not agent output. Final assistant message was a plain completion report; no question was asked to me at any point.
